title: Finite-stage detection of zero affine sections
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $J$ a small cofiltered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $D:J\to X_{\acute{e}t}$ be a diagram [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] whose underlying schemes are affine [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and whose structure maps to $X$ are open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]. Let $c$ be a limit cone of the underlying scheme diagram, and $p:c.pt\to X$ satisfy $c_j$ followed by the structure map of $D_j$ equals $p$. Let $F$ be an abelian sheaf on $X_{\acute{e}t}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and let $H$ be a functor from abelian sheaves on $X$ to those on $c.pt$, with an adjunction $hH:H\dashv p_*$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Let $T$ denote the terminal etale object of $c.pt$. Let $\nu:D^{op}F\to\operatorname{const}(H(F)(T))$ be a natural transformation whose $j$-component is the unit $F(D_j)\to H(F)(D_j\times_X c.pt)$ followed by restriction along the map $T\to D_j\times_X c.pt$ with components $c_j$ and the identity [def-pc-fibre-product]. For every $j\in J$ and $s\in F(D_j)$, if $\nu_j(s)=0$, there are $k\in J$ and $f:k\to j$ such that $F(D(f)^{op})(s)=0$.

source.place: Degree-zero specialization of lemma-colimit, steps (1)-(3); inverse-image section formula in Sites Tag 0A35 (lemma-pullback-to-limit)

proof.text: Fix a stage j0 (in zero detection, use the given j). Work over the cofiltered category of arrows k to j0. Its projection is initial; cofilteredness supplies refinements and equalizes parallel arrows. The same cone is limiting after this restriction. Reindex by a nonempty directed inverse system. All stages and transitions are affine; each structure map to the fixed affine stage is an open immersion.

Apply affine-etale-site continuity to this affine system. Objects, arrows, equality of arrows, and finite covers on the limit descend to stages. Apply the inverse-image section formula for the colimit site at the terminal object. The formula is a filtered colimit over stages mapping to j0 of sections of the pullback of F restricted to D(j0).

For each open immersion D(k) to X, the localization-restriction comparison identifies the pullback sections with F(D(k)). Its unit formula identifies the transition maps with F applied to D arrows. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives an isomorphism from the constructed pullback to H carrying its unit to hH.unit. Evaluate this isomorphism at the terminal object; naturality and the supplied component formula identify the colimit legs with nu.

Compare the given section s with the zero section at the fixed stage j. Equality of their images in the filtered colimit is detected after one transition. This yields an arrow from a later stage k to j and equality of the restriction of s with the restriction of zero, which is zero since the restriction is a group homomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Degree-zero continuity, expanded using affine-site continuity and the inverse-image section formula

mathlib_searches.query: Every section of an inverse image etale abelian sheaf on an affine limit descends to a stage and a section becoming zero vanishes at a later stage
sections of an etale sheaf on inverse limit of affine open schemes are the filtered colimit

lean.statement: theorem affineOpenSections_zero_detection {X : Scheme.{u + 1}} {J : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory J] [IsCofiltered J] (D : J ⥤ X.Etale) [∀ j, IsAffine (D.obj j).left] [∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (D.obj j).hom] (c : Cone (D ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X ⋙ Over.forget X)) (p : c.pt ⟶ X) (hp : ∀ j, c.π.app j ≫ (D.obj j).hom = p) (hc : IsLimit c) (H : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hH : H ⊣ p.Etale.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X.smallEtaleTopology c.pt.smallEtaleTopology) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (ν₀ : D.op ⋙ F.obj ⟶ (Functor.const Jᵒᵖ).obj ((H.obj F).obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt))))) (hν₀ : ∀ j, ν₀.app (op j) = (hH.unit.app F).hom.app (op (D.obj j)) ≫ (H.obj F).obj.map (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (B := p.Etale.obj (D.obj j)) (pullback.lift (c.π.app j) (𝟙 c.pt) (by change c.π.app j ≫ (D.obj j).hom = 𝟙 c.pt ≫ p rw [Category.id_comp] exact hp j)) (by exact pullback.lift_snd _ _ _)).op) : ∀ (j : J) (s : F.obj.obj (op (D.obj j))), ν₀.app (op j) s = 0 → ∃ (k : J) (f : k ⟶ j), F.obj.map (D.map f).op s = 0
